title: mapped XSUAA identity resolves one active IDTS user
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / XSUAA / HANA
testCommand: Browser Control authenticated AppRouter request plus bounded HANA aggregate readback
actualResult: AuthService.me returned HTTP 200 with PM and User Administration capability. Protected Bugs OData returned HTTP 200 and count 19. Active Users showed the same account as Active with Identity link Yes. HANA reported 6 linked active users and the same aggregate state before and after.
assertions: AuthService.me returned HTTP 200 with PM and User Administration capability.
Protected Bugs OData returned HTTP 200 and count 19.
Active Users showed the same account as Active with Identity link Yes.
HANA reported 6 linked active users and the same aggregate state before and after.
limitations: Proves the authorized mapped PM path. Tester and Developer role-specific acceptance remain outside this case run.
